content.comment_body: I'm using the [article_no] version of the [product_name] (230V), and I have a 0-10V source. Will this setup work? Can I connect it to I7 or I8, or is that only for the 24V model?

Only [product_name] base modules powered purely by DC voltage support analog inputs. If the power supply is only DC, analog inputs are available. If the power supply is a mix of AC/DC, or only AC, analog inputs are not supported.

You can achieve this if you use an expansion unit next to the main [product_name]. The expansion unit (such as [article_no]) must be provided with a 24V DC power supply. With this setup, it is possible.

analysis.insight_summary: Users were unsure whether the [product_name] with article number [article_no] (230V version) could directly handle a 0-10V analog input. It was clarified that only DC-powered base modules provide onboard analog input compatibility. If the module is powered by AC or has mixed supply, analog inputs aren't available. Additional analog input capability is possible via expansion units powered by 24V DC. This exchange illustrates the need for clear information on analog input support across different module versions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes the [product_name] (230V AC version) will directly accept a 0-10V analog input on inputs I7 or I8, or seeks a clear explanation on how to achieve this functionality.
